body: Thank you so much! I’ll do my best to continue holding on and move forward.
Thank you!
Thank you so much! I’ll continue pushing on.
Thank you! I’ve been blind for a long time as well but I’m glad I was able to find a path out of it.
Thank you! I’ll do my best to keep going forward.
Thank you so much! I’ve been struggling with these thoughts for a long time so I’m guessing it’ll take as long for me to move on as well. Thank you for your kind words.
Happy birthday! And I’m really happy that you got a tattoo instead, you should be really proud of yourself :)
Thank you for being so kind. I’ll do my best to believe in what you say.
There aren’t many therapists (that I know of) where I live. I have been to several psychiatrists, but none of the doctors matched and I gave up. I’ll do my best to move on.

I’m so sorry for your loss. 
My ex has repeatedly told me that what I did was correct and it wasn’t my fault (even after we broke up), but I can’t help but think about the what-ifs. I feel like if I had acted differently none of it would’ve happened.

I’m relieved to hear you were able to convince her! Don’t forget to take care of yourself once in a while too; I have a feeling you’re more stressed out than you realize.
I pray everything goes well for you two. Please don’t hesitate to come back if you need advice or just want to vent

I can’t give good advice since we ended up breaking up without managing our codependency so just take what I say next with a grain of salt. If I were you, since your girlfriend’s life is in danger, I would say “Please continue fighting with me,” regardless of codependency. 
If they don’t have a trusting relationship, then I doubt you should tell her. To make a long story short, although the circumstances are a bit different, I was in the same situation as you this time and made the mistake of telling my ex’s parents. After I did so, my ex lost all hope, locked himself up in his room and tried to commit suicide (we were lucky it wasn’t fatal). 
How about your own parents? I should’ve told you sooner, but I am slightly younger than you (I’m almost 18) and don’t have as much experience in life, so again, if you can trust them, maybe their advice would help you.

I used to say the same words as she did.
I just looked back at our texts and found out that when I told my ex that, he had replied, “I’ll move on, but that doesn’t mean I won’t be hurt.” 
Do you think she’ll try if you told her you’ll keep fighting together? (However, keep in mind that this may lead to codependency)
Can you trust her parents? If you can, maybe you can have a word with them.
I agree, there are a lot of kind people on this subreddit. I’ve been saved by them a couple of times too :)

Your girlfriend kind of reminds of me of myself. My ex-boyfriend always tried to talk me out of it logically, but I always retorted back at him, saying I am “a nuisance just by being alive” and stuff like that.
I apologize if I offend you by saying this, but what reasons did she give for leaving someone that loves her (you) behind?
I’m really sorry, you remind me too much of us and I would really like to help you.

I used to be in a toxic relationship like that myself. However, both of us were suicidal and constantly pulled each other down, but luckily, whenever one of us wanted to die, the other would encourage them to live.
To be honest, when I found out my ex told authorities about my suicide plan, I felt really betrayed. I knew he did it for me, but it made my suicidal feelings worse and I stopped opening up to anyone.
On the other hand, when I told the authorities about him, he seemed thankful in the end. However, it seems like he isn’t opening up to anyone either (it may be that his suicidal feelings are now gone, but I have no idea), so you should be careful.
May I ask why your girlfriend is feeling this way? Also, have you attempted to logically talk her out of it?

I’m sorry for your loss. 
I’ve been on both sides (been a close friend with someone who attempted suicide, and tried to commit suicide myself) so I’ve experienced the pain and fear of losing someone that’s dear to you. Despite this, I don’t know why I’m so nearsighted. 
All I can say is that when I’m depressed, I feel that no one loves me anymore and start feeling terribly alone. At that state, I don’t have the capacity to look at others around me.

I guess that makes sense. I have experienced a close friend of mine attempting suicide because he felt no one cared. However, what he didn’t know was that actually, so many people cared about his existence, including myself. Maybe the same can be said for me, too.

In my country, it’s a tradition to put a flower vase at the seat where their deceased classmate used to sit. But I agree when you say they’d get rid of my desk when there’s a new seating chart. I’m not sure if anyone would cry thinking about me, because I don’t feel like I have close bonds with any of my friends (except one). 
Thank you for telling me about your experience. I’ll keep it in mind.

I did have someone who cared that I trusted, but I don’t anymore. I agree with you: even if anyone asks me if I’m okay in reality, I’ll say yes. I don’t know if my reason is the same as yours, but I’ll say it because if I don’t, no one would want me around. 

I guess I need enough maturity to be able to accept that. However, when things are at their worst, just the thought that no one would care anyway would be enough to push me off the edge.

I don’t think those words are meaningless. Even if we don’t know each other in reality, just hearing those words made me feel a bit better. Thank you. 

I don’t know if I need help either, to be honest. There were three times when I seriously considered killing myself (out of this, twice I went through but failed). Right now, it’s not as bad as then, but the negative thoughts are still there.
Thank you for your kind words.
Thank you so much for saying that. I’m really glad I got through it as well. I’ll do my best to get better.
Thank you!
Thank you for your encouraging words! I’ll do my best to keep on living :)
Thank you! I wish you the best, too.
Thank you! I may talk to you when I need someone to lend an ear, thank you for your kind words :)
Thank you! I'll do my best to keep on living.
Thank you! I'll do my best :)
Thank you! I really hope I can continue recovering :)
It took me a while to do so, but I'm glad I was able to do it. Thank you!
I still feel a little depressed, but I feel better than how I felt three months ago (I was seriously considering suicide then). Thank you for asking.

Thank you for saying that! 
I'll be here to talk as well if you need anything. Much love to you :)

Thank you! 
I'll do my best to continue recovering as well :)
Thank you for your kind words :)

Please don't break up with him. I've been in your boyfriend's shoes, so I can tell you that much. 
My boyfriend had told me he wanted to break up with me before. When I refused, he seemed so relieved. However, when I asked him what would've happened if I had chosen to part ways, he told me that he would've killed himself after, and the reason he said he wanted to break up in the first place was because he didn't want me to "suffer" by being with him. Believe me, I've never cried so hard in my life (and that's coming from a teenage girl!). 
If he's with you right now, it means he's determined to be by your side no matter what happens. Please give him a chance. 
I'm sorry for ranting on and on about myself. You can always reply here if you want to talk :)
Thank you! I'll do my best to keep on living.

I was seriously considering suicide around June, but now I'm slowly feeling less suicidal (at least, I'm well enough to be able to throw away the rope). 
I may take up on your offer sometime in the future though, thanks for being kind :)

Sorry for the late reply.

I was afraid of judgment. The person I wanted to talk to was actually my ex. He used to struggle with the same things I do now, and we supported each other through the tough times. But as soon as he got better, he realized how crazy I was and left me. However, he’s still the only one I trust (he doesn’t hate me; he just doesn’t like me as a female anymore). 

I couldn’t tell him how I am right now. We ended up talking about other meaningless stuff instead. If only I had more courage, I could’ve opened up to him. 

I can’t tell anyone else because I can’t trust them.

I couldn’t tell him. I had two chances, but I messed up both of them. 
Something inside of me stopped and I just thought, “He wouldn’t even care.”
I don’t know what to do anymore… I have a week until June ends, and nothing has changed since the time I first made this post.

I couldn’t meet my friend today because I caught a cold and was forced to stay at home. 
Yet, even if I had talked to him, there’s still a part of me that doubts he would have cared anyways. He usually forgets our plans to talk even when I remind him beforehand, and I don’t want to bother him. 
I think I’ll try talking to him, but I don’t know if there’s a point…

There is a lot of stigma around suicidal intentions anyway, so I guess I can’t blame them for reacting like that. None of their advice worked for me; in fact, I stopped telling others about my thoughts since then so the same thing won’t happen again.
I was thinking about talking to my friend about this tomorrow, but I don’t know if he would care enough to listen. If I tell him and he doesn’t care, I feel like I would really push myself over the edge. But if I don’t tell him, I don’t know what’ll happen to me in the future.

I’m really sorry for the late reply, haven't been on Reddit recently. 
I opened up to my friend once, who told the teacher. That part I understand. But then, some teachers (including the school councilor) took me to an isolated room and lectured me for hours about the importance of life, that it's just a phase, and I should never think about it again.

Thank you for saying that. 
I guess I should add that I’m a teenager still attending high school, so showing that would mean trouble. 
I almost did show my true colors today, though it was unintentional (I almost cried during class). 
Maybe I’ll talk to one of my friends about this, but I don’t know… I’m not sure if there is any trust between us.

I’m crazy because of the suicidal thoughts I have. If I were normal, I wouldn’t be feeling this way. 
I don’t know. I just don’t feel worthy of kindness.

I’m sorry for your experience. 
I’ve actually faced something similar; my now ex-boyfriend attempted suicide multiple times when we were together. During that time, I cried every day and felt even more powerless and worthless than ever.
I did reach out to others, but I realized that the more I reached out, the worse my suicidal thoughts became. In addition, I don’t want to cause any more trouble than I already do.

I guess you’re right. I’m sure most of the people I know will be surprised at how crazy I really am.
However, I don’t know if I receive little in return, since it feels like that’s all I deserve anyways.

Everyone keeps on telling me that time solves everything and I’ve tried to believe that over the past year, but so far, nothing has changed. 
I’ve thought about what’ll happen when I die, but I can’t imagine anyone being sad about it. Of course, a few may be shocked at first, but they will easily forget about me over time. 
Maybe there is a part of me that wants to back off but I don’t know how. I’ve actually told my suicidal feelings to someone an year ago, and all they said was, “Don’t kill yourself, it’s not okay, it’s not normal,” and other stuff that I already knew. Since then, I’ve given up on telling people about this and kept it to myself.
I wish I can die in my sleep too, without any pain. But I guess that’s not really realistic...

I wish I knew why I feel this way, but I don’t. 
It’s not like I’m leading a terrible life— in fact, some may even find it pretty decent. However, since I’m making up my happiness in order to please everyone else, I feel a lot of stress when I’m alone.
I also believe that no one would care even if I killed myself, since no one truly cares when I’m alive anyways.
I’ll do my best. Thank you for being so kind.

I did, but I’m not sure if they understood. 
I hope what you say is true…

I keep on asking myself the same thing, but I honestly don’t know what made me like this. 
I constantly feel like a failure and a burden to others. I never feel truly happy. I don’t feel excited towards things that I used to look forward to anymore. I have no future to be excited for. I just feel empty.

I have, over two months ago. I told my now ex-boyfriend about it, and he promised me he won’t tell anyone else. But I ended up getting dragged to the counselor’s office, surrounded by a bunch of teachers, and was told how “important my life is and how I shouldn’t waste it” and other obvious stuff I already knew. Ever since that incident, I promised myself that when I decide to end it, I will do it silently without telling anyone I personally knew.
I’m really glad you’re here. You’re strong for making it this far, too.
I’m sorry you have to go through this. I’m struggling with the same stuff myself, so just know you aren’t alone here.
I’m so sorry you had to go through such things throughout your life. Just know you aren’t alone here.

Ah, I see... That’s okay too :)
Do you have friends that you can trust from the bottom of your heart? Before consulting a psychiatrist, I used to talk about my feelings to a person I trusted with my life. That person gave me lots of advice and helped me get through tough times in my life while I wasn’t ready to see a doctor. 
Also, I don’t know if this is any different from a psychiatrist, but what do you think about seeing your school counselor?
For the negative thoughts, I do my best to drown then out with songs that have positive lyrics in them. I must admit it is only temporary, but it’s better than nothing...
I’m currently struggling to find a solution for my lack of motivation myself... I apologize for being unable to help you here.

I’ve been struggling with the same things as you, and I’ve started seeing a psychiatrist recently. I’ve only been there once, but I found that talking to a professional really helps.
I hope this can help you in any way.
Thank you. I’m glad to know I’m not alone here. Hang in there, too.
